description: Establish core development workflow and tooling fundamentals. Master version control, professional repository hygiene, and project organization patterns that will support CatchBook development throughout all 28 phases.
catchbook_focus: Set up CatchBook repository with professional Git workflow, documentation standards, and project management infrastructure. Establish the foundation for collaborative development and continuous deployment.
entry_criteria: Basic computer literacy (file management, web browsing)
Terminal/command line familiarity (ability to navigate directories, run commands)
Text editor comfort (VS Code, Sublime, or similar)
exit_criteria: CatchBook repository initialized with proper structure
Professional README with project overview and setup instructions
Git workflow mastery (commit, branch, merge, PR)
Conventional Commits adherence for all commits
GitHub Issues board configured with initial CatchBook feature backlog
First meaningful contribution to CatchBook merged via PR

modules.module_name: Git fundamentals: init add commit push
modules.catchbook_deliverable: CatchBook repository setup with README and initial commit
First feature branch merged to CatchBook via pull request
Professional repo hygiene with Conventional Commits and PR template
CatchBook feature board with milestones and issue tracking
